# Tianxing Ren

> Doctoral researcher at Peking University. AI compilers, tile-level programming, and heterogeneous computing.

I research AI compilers so that diverse AI algorithms can run correctly and efficiently on emerging AI hardware. I aim to make programming easier for people and agents.

## Profile and projects

- [About](https://tianxingren-work.github.io/machine/en/about.md): education, advisors, internships, awards, and visits.
- [TileLang-TPU](https://tianxingren-work.github.io/machine/en/projects/tilelang-tpu.md): project lead; stage milestone-complete; open source true.
- [TileLang-RISC-V](https://tianxingren-work.github.io/machine/en/projects/tilelang-riscv.md): project lead; stage in-progress; open source false.

## Reading this site

This site is hosted as static files on GitHub Pages. Read the Markdown and JSON URLs directly; they work without JavaScript or a backend. HTML pages link to their alternate files in the document head. Recognized agent user agents in browsers that execute JavaScript are directed to the localized agent page. GitHub Pages does not select response content from the User-Agent or Accept header.

For research collaboration, use the contact page at https://tianxingren-work.github.io/contact/ or the linked GitHub profiles.
